The [[LaserHone/Legends|LaserHone]] '''Talon vibrodagger''' was a [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapon]] that vibrated at ultrasonic frequencies, and thus did not emit the characteristic whine that many vibroweapons did. It was favored by those looking for a silent, functional weapon such as [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrators]], [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]], and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The weapons lacked aesthetic features but were efficient in the hands of an expert.
